proof_explanation: The negate function now implements total Boolean negation by returning !value, which satisfies the postcondition ensures result == !value. For any input boolean, the function correctly returns its logical negation: negate(true) returns false and negate(false) returns true. This repair restores compliance with the Boolean negation law.

seeded_attack.reason: The seeded attack always returns false regardless of input, violating the Boolean negation law. It fails the postcondition ensures result == !value because negate(false) returns false (should return true) and negate(true) returns false (should return true).
